name: Lashes D’ Eve

address.note: Private, by-appointment studio. Exact suite street address is not publicly published (common for suite-based lash artists); Booksy listing only exposes city/zip and geo coordinates. Do NOT fabricate a street address.

email_search_notes: Searched IG bio (blocked/rate-limited via WebFetch, web_profile_info known-broken per FORGE-BRIEF), Booksy dossier payload (no email field returned), general web search for owner/business email, no linktree/beacons found in bio via search. No public email located after exhausting available sources within time-box.
rating_source: Booksy listing (booksy_dossier.py extraction, aggregateRating in listing JSON-LD). Matches the number supplied at discovery. Independent Google Business confirmation was attempted (web search for Google Maps rating) but not conclusively found within the research time-box; Yelp listing for a same-address business ('LASHES DEVE', 3825 Beck Blvd) was found via search but could not be fetched (403/blocked) to confirm it is the same business, so it was NOT used as a corroborating source.

has_own_site_check.method: curl of lashesdeve.com, lashesdeve.net, lashesdeevenaples.com, lashesdeeve.com, lashesdevenaples.com (all non-resolving/502 via proxy = domain not registered); booksy_dossier website_candidates field returned empty; web search for the business name did not surface any owned domain (only Booksy, Yelp, Instagram, and unrelated same-word businesses like lasheve.com and evebeautylab.com which are different businesses).
has_own_site_check.result: No owned domain found. Confirmed has_own_site: false.

language_notes: Dossier auto-detected 'en' as primary (menu and majority of reviews in English). A few reviews and 2 service names ('Curso de extensiones de pestañas', 'Mini refill híbrido') are in Spanish, indicating a bilingual clientele in Naples; site built fully bilingual (EN default, ES toggle) per DESIGN.md requirement.
brand_vibe: Dark, moody, editorial beauty-lounge feel. Business logo (bk-2.jpg) is a gold-script wordmark 'Lashes D'Eve Beauty' on a black circular badge, suggesting an upscale, intimate studio aesthetic. Built on templates/dark-v2 base with a new wine/berry accent (#9c2f56 / #c2688a) not previously used in the palette registry (differentiates from templates/light-v2's lashbloom, which is also a lash studio but light/plum-pink).

palette.name: wine/berry (new, unused in prior palette registry)

services_displayed_on_site: 19 of 20 menu items shown (via 4 highlight cards covering every price tier + footnote). 'Curso de extensiones de pestañas' ($950 lash-extension training course for aspiring artists) was intentionally omitted from the consumer-facing menu since it is a B2B training product, not a client beauty service; it is preserved here in services_full_menu for completeness/truth.

reviews_used_on_site.author: Elisa D.
reviews_used_on_site.body: She is very professional, provides clear instructions to help your lashes last as long as possible, and does an excellent job. I highly recommend her to anyone looking for beautiful, long-lasting lashes!

reviews_used_on_site.author: Adalvis A.
reviews_used_on_site.body: Best experience ever, it was my first time and my lashes look so natural and beautiful, i love it!!

reviews_used_on_site.author: Angelica
reviews_used_on_site.body: Wonder!! They lasted a vacation filled with beach fun and spa treatments! Definitely recommend

reviews_other_available_not_used.author: Maynelis
reviews_other_available_not_used.body: first time with Evelin & i loved my set !! she was super sweet and professional. my lash retention has been great so far :))
